newsitem.title: USA: Goodmark Foods optimistic on profits in 98.
newsitem.headline: Goodmark Foods optimistic on profits in 98.

text.p: GoodMark Foods Inc said Tuesday it is optimistic about resuming a more consistent growth rate and increased profitability in fiscal 1998.
The company said it is entering fiscal 1998 with sales on the upswing and with solid momentum for its branded meat snacks, especially Slim Jim.
It said the divestiture of packaged meats will enhance its focus and will provide additional capacity to meet growing demand for its more profitable meat snack business.

The company said it has reclassified all sales and earnings of the Jesse Jones packaged meats business into discontinued operations for the 1997 fiscal year and 1996 fiscal year for comparison purposes.
The company reported earnings per share for the quarter of $0.19 compared to $0.13.
